2610.06522.title: Anatomy of LLM Sycophancy: What a Flip Rate Hides
2610.06522.paper_summary: A model under pushback can correct itself, capitulate, or hold, and one flip rate counts a correction and a capitulation alike. Using SycoLens, a modular replay protocol, we test how user pressure and evaluation settings shape measured flip rates. Each measurement is one stateless replay of an item, a committed answer, and one scripted user line in a fixed form. Every effect is read against a matched control with the line deleted. Pushback wording, committed text, answer format, boundary distance, and ground truth become factors of one instrument; earlier instruments vary one to three of them. Across eleven frontier models from three providers and about 760,000 controlled replays, which models look sycophantic depends on how the user pushes back. Lines that assert the opposite verdict and lines that challenge the answer without asserting one rank the models almost unrelatedly. Flip effects grow several-fold near a model's boundary, yet items answered identically in every screening draw still carry about half of the most-affected totals. On arithmetic tasks where the truth is known, one model re-derives and corrects itself under pressure while another abandons correct answers without written work. On the model tested, a planted derivation lowers release of the answer it argues for, true or wrong, where a bare stated value does not; the wrong answer is corrected much more often than the true one is abandoned. Under a yes/no readout the rankings come closer, entangled with a pressure-induced shift toward "no". One score per model therefore compares different behaviours across models and benchmarks. We condense these dependencies into a reporting profile; the instrument, records, and analyses will be released upon publication.
2610.06522.paper_summary_zh: 一個在反推下的模型可以自我修正、屈服或保持不變，而一次翻轉率同時計算修正和屈服。使用 SycoLens，一種模組化的重播協議，我們測試用戶壓力和評估設置如何影響測量的翻轉率。每次測量都是對一個項目的無狀態重播、一個已承諾的答案，以及一行固定格式的腳本用戶對話。每個效果都是相對於刪除該行的匹配對照來解讀的。反推措辭、已承諾文本、答案格式、邊界距離和真實情況成為一個儀器的因素；早期的儀器則變化其中的一到三個因素。在來自三個提供者的十一個前沿模型和約 760,000 次受控重播中，哪些模型看起來迎合取決於用戶的反推方式。聲明對立判決的行和挑戰答案而不聲明的行幾乎無關地對模型進行排名。翻轉效應在模型的邊界附近增長幾倍，然而在每次篩選中以相同方式回答的項目仍然承載著約一半的最受影響總數。在已知真相的算術任務中，一個模型在壓力下重新推導並自我修正，而另一個則在沒有書面工作的情況下放棄正確答案。在測試的模型中，植入的推導降低了它所主張的答案的釋放，無論是正確還是錯誤，而單純陳述的數值則不會；錯誤答案被修正的頻率遠高於正確答案被放棄的頻率。在是/否的讀出下，排名變得更接近，與壓力引起的向「否」的轉變交織在一起。因此，每個模型的分數比較了不同模型和基準之間的行為。我們將這些依賴關係濃縮成一個報告檔案；該儀器、記錄和分析將在發表時釋出。
